stem: A company runs a containerized application using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. The workload varies throughout the day. A solutions architect notices that nodes do not scale automatically when the existing nodes reach the cluster's maximum capacity, causing performance problems. Which solution addresses this issue with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.text: Scale nodes by tracking memory utilization.
Use Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
Use an AWS Lambda function to automatically resize the EKS cluster.
Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to distribute the workload.

stem: A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 AWS accounts. The company creates a new AWS Cost and Usage Report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in a data collection account. Senior leadership wants a custom dashboard updated daily that shows NAT gateway costs from the beginning of the current month. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure QuickSight to query the new report using AWS DataSync.
Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure QuickSight to query the new report using Amazon Athena.
Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure CloudWatch to query the new report using AWS DataSync.
Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure CloudWatch to query the new report using Amazon Athena.

stem: A company's on-premises volume backup solution is approaching end of life. The company wants to use AWS as part of a new backup solution while retaining local access to all data. Data backed up to AWS must be transferred automatically and securely. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use AWS Snowball to migrate data from the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Configure on-premises systems to mount the Snowball S3 endpoint for local data access.
Use AWS Snowball Edge to migrate data from the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Use the Snowball Edge file interface to provide local data access to on-premises systems.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a cached volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and configure a portion of the data to be cached locally. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local data access.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a stored volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and map the gateway storage volumes to local storage. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local data access.

stem: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake managed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create Amazon QuickSight visualizations by joining data in the data lake with operational data stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company must enforce column-level authorization so that the marketing team can access only certain database columns. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Use Amazon EMR to import data directly from the database into the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.

Use AWS Glue Studio to import data from the database into the S3 data lake. Attach IAM policies to QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create materialized views of the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use Lake Formation blueprints to import data from the database into the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

stem: A company runs a custom application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. The application's frontend nodes must run continuously, while backend nodes run for short periods as the workload requires. The number of backend nodes varies throughout the day. The company needs to scale out and scale in instances according to the workload. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.
Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.
Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Reserved Instances for the backend nodes.
Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.

stem: A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A newly hired solutions architect discovers that former employees did not provide a detailed resource inventory. The solutions architect needs to build a map of the relationships among the various workloads in all accounts. Which solution meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently?

options.text: Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from a detailed view report.
Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Manually build architecture diagrams of the workloads.
Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
Use AWS X-Ray to view workload details. Build architecture diagrams with the relationships.

stem: A company has an online gaming application with TCP and UDP multiplayer functionality. The company uses Amazon Route 53 to direct application traffic to multiple Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in different AWS Regions. The company needs to improve application performance and reduce online gaming latency as the number of users grows. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the NLBs. Increase the Cache-Control max-age parameter.
Replace the NLBs with Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Configure Route 53 to use latency-based routing.
Add AWS Global Accelerator in front of the NLBs. Configure a Global Accelerator endpoint to use the correct listener ports.
Add Amazon API Gateway endpoints behind the NLBs. Enable API caching. Override method caching for different stages.

stem: A company has a nightly batch job that analyzes report files received daily through SFTP into an on-premises file system. The company wants to migrate the solution to the AWS Cloud. The solution must be highly available and resilient and must minimize operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to perform the batch operations.

Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance running Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with a minimum capacity and desired capacity of 1.

Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance running Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with a minimum capacity and desired capacity of 1.

Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket. Modify the application to pull batch files from Amazon S3 to an Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to perform the batch operations.

stem: A company is building a data analytics platform on AWS using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution that prevents access to portions of the data containing sensitive information. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create an IAM role with permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
Create an AWS Lambda function to remove sensitive information before the data is imported into Lake Formation.
Create an AWS Lambda function to periodically query and remove sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.

stem: A company exposes its application to the internet through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company discovers unusual traffic access patterns in the application. A solutions architect needs to improve infrastructure visibility to help the company understand these anomalies. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution?

options.text: Create a table in Amazon Athena for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create a query to retrieve the relevant information.
Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Create a table in Amazon Athena and query the logs.
Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Open each file in a text editor and search each line for relevant information.
Use Amazon EMR on a dedicated Amazon EC2 instance to query the ALB directly for traffic access log information.

stem: A company connects its corporate data center to a VPC in us-east-1 through an AWS Direct Connect connection. The company recently acquired another company that has multiple VPCs and a Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and eu-west-2. The companies' VPC CIDR blocks do not overlap. The company needs connectivity between the two Regions and the data centers. The solution must be scalable and reduce operational overhead. How should a solutions architect meet these requirements?

options.text: Establish inter-Region VPC peering between the VPCs in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2.
Create a private virtual interface from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2.
Deploy VPN appliances hosted on Amazon EC2 in a full-mesh VPN network. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC.
Connect the existing Direct Connect connections to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway.

stem: A company's application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The application must receive data from a third-party application in real time. The company needs a data ingestion solution that places the collected raw data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream for data ingestion. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to consume the Kinesis data stream. Specify the S3 bucket as the delivery stream's destination.

Create a database migration task in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify a replication instance for the EC2 instances as the source endpoint. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes.
Create and configure an AWS DataSync agent on the EC2 instances. Configure a DataSync task to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket.

Create an AWS Direct Connect connection for data ingestion. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to consume PUT operations directly from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the delivery stream's destination.

stem: A disaster response team uses drones to collect images of damage caused by a recent storm. The team's laptops lack the storage and compute capacity to transfer the images and process the data. Although the team has Amazon EC2 instances for processing and Amazon S3 buckets for storage, network connectivity is intermittent and unreliable. The images must be processed to assess the damage. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text: Use an AWS Snowball Edge device to process and store the images.
Upload the images to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) during periods of intermittent connectivity to the EC2 instances.
Configure Amazon Data Firehose with separate delivery streams for the S3 buckets and EC2 instances to process the images.
Use AWS Storage Gateway preinstalled on a hardware appliance to cache the images locally so that Amazon S3 can process them when connectivity is available.

stem: A company hosts its ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The application uses a multi-Region active-active approach and multiple microservices. The company needs a solution that redirects traffic when resources in an AWS Region become unavailable. The company wants to ensure that the failover Region can handle the traffic during a failover. Which solution provides application resilience with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Use the multi-Region recovery capabilities of Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller.

Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to monitor multi-Region endpoints and redirect traffic. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to schedule occasional resource shutdowns in the primary Region to verify that the failover Region is ready to handle traffic.
Use AWS Fault Injection Service to reroute traffic to another Region if resources in one Region become unavailable.

Deploy Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs in each Region. Use an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use Lambda@Edge to query Amazon Route 53 for the Region to which requests should be forwarded based on the lowest latency.

stem: A company is developing a social media application. The company expects rapid and unpredictable growth in users and data volume. The application must continuously process large numbers of user requests, including long-running processes that store large amounts of user-generated content and user profiles in a relational format. The processes must run in a specific order. The architecture must scale resources during demand spikes without downtime or performance degradation. Individual components must be able to evolve independently without affecting the rest of the system. Which combination of AWS services meets these requirements?

options.text: Deploy the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to decouple message processing between components.

Deploy the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to decouple message processing between components.

Use Amazon DynamoDB as the database. Implement the application with AWS Lambda functions. Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams to invoke the Lambda functions. Use AWS Step Functions to manage workflows between services.

Deploy the application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment with automatic scaling. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to decouple message processing between components.

stem: A company deploys an application in two AWS Regions. If the application becomes unavailable in one Region, it must fail over to the second Region. The failover process must avoid stale DNS client caches. The company wants a single endpoint to access both copies of the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use an Amazon CloudFront distribution with multiple origins. Associate each origin with the application in its respective Region.
Use an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy with equal weights to route client requests when the original Region becomes unavailable.
Use AWS Global Accelerator and assign a static anycast IP address to the application endpoint.
Use an Amazon Route 53 IP-based routing policy to route requests to the second Region if the application becomes unavailable in the original Region.

stem: A company operates an online photo-sharing service and stores data in a centralized Amazon S3 bucket in AWS account A. The company wants to grant a second AWS account, account B, access to the centralized S3 bucket. The company owns account B. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration so that account B can access the centralized S3 bucket in account A.
Enable cross-Region replication between account A and account B to share the S3 bucket data.
Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute the S3 bucket contents. Grant account B access to the bucket contents through signed URLs.
Create a bucket policy that allows account B to access the centralized S3 bucket in account A.

stem: A company manages an application that stores data in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. High application traffic increases the latency of many read queries. A solutions architect must improve the application's performance. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Enable Amazon RDS Performance Insights. Configure storage autoscaling.
Configure the DB instance to use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
Create a read replica of the DB instance. Serve read traffic from the read replica.
Use Amazon Data Firehose between the application and Amazon RDS to increase database request concurrency.

stem: A company wants to optimize the cost of its AWS infrastructure. The company wants to receive notifications when actual or forecasted costs exceed a specified budget. The company does not want to develop a custom solution. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to set up budget notifications. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs. Export the CloudWatch data to Amazon S3. Use machine learning (ML) to estimate future trends based on the CloudWatch data.

Create a budget in AWS Budgets with a specific cost threshold. Create an AWS Lambda function to notify the company when costs reach the specified threshold. Use AWS Billing and Cost Management reports to monitor costs.

Use AWS Cost Explorer to set a specified budget threshold. Create an AWS Lambda function to calculate cost estimates. Configure the function to notify an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if estimated costs exceed the threshold.

Create a budget in AWS Budgets with a specific cost threshold. Configure AWS Budgets to send budget alerts to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use AWS Cost Explorer to monitor costs.

stem: A company has a website that handles a dynamically changing traffic load. The website runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group configured for scheduled scaling. Each EC2 instance runs code from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume and writes shared data to the same volume. The company wants to optimize the website's cost. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Reconfigure the Auto Scaling group with a fixed desired number of instances. Disable scheduled scaling.
Create a new launch template version for the Auto Scaling group that uses larger EC2 instances.
Reconfigure the Auto Scaling group to use a target tracking scaling policy.
Replace the EFS volume with instance store volumes.

stem: A company is developing a SaaS solution for its customers. The solution runs on Amazon EC2 instances with attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Customers can request the amount of storage they need, and the application must allocate that amount of block storage to each customer. A solutions architect must design an operationally efficient solution that meets the storage scaling requirements. Which solution is MOST cost-effective?

options.text: Migrate the data from the EBS volumes to Amazon S3 buckets. Use the S3 Standard storage class.

Migrate the data from the EBS volumes to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Use the EFS Standard storage class. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to increase EFS capacity based on user input.
Migrate the data from the EBS volumes to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to increase the file system's capacity based on user input.
Invoke an AWS Lambda function to increase the EBS volume size based on user input by using EBS Elastic Volumes.

stem: A company is building a serverless application that processes large amounts of data from a mobile application. The application uses AWS Lambda functions to process the data and stores it in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must ensure that the application can recover from failures and continue processing without losing any records. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Configure the Lambda functions with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. Configure Lambda to retry failed records from the dead-letter queue. Implement an exponential backoff algorithm for retries.
Configure the Lambda functions to read records from Amazon Data Firehose. Replay the Firehose records if a failure occurs.
Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to store failed records. Configure AWS Lambda to retry the failed records from OpenSearch Service. Use Amazon EventBridge to coordinate the retry logic.
Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to store failed records. Configure Lambda to retry failed records from the SNS topic. Use Amazon API Gateway to coordinate the retry invocations.

stem: A company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS provider. The company hosts its website both on premises and in the AWS Cloud. Its on-premises data center is near us-west-1, and its AWS-hosted website is in eu-central-1. The company wants to optimize website load times as much as possible. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Create a DNS record with a failover routing policy that routes all primary traffic to eu-central-1. Configure the on-premises data center as the secondary location.

Create a DNS record with an IP-based routing policy. Configure specific IP ranges to return the value for the eu-central-1 website. Configure all other IP ranges to return the value for the on-premises website.
Create a DNS record with a latency-based routing policy. Associate the record for the on-premises data center with us-west-1.
Create a DNS record with a weighted routing policy. Distribute traffic equally between eu-central-1 and the on-premises data center.

stem: A healthcare company is designing a system to store and manage logs in the AWS Cloud. The system will receive and store logs in JSON format. The logs contain sensitive patient information. The company must identify sensitive data and be able to search the log data with SQL queries. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Store the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon Macie to discover sensitive data. Use Amazon Athena to query the logs.
Store the logs on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Create an application that uses Amazon SageMaker AI to detect sensitive data. Use Amazon RDS to query the logs.
Store the logs in Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to discover sensitive data. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query the logs.
Store the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Inspector to discover sensitive data. Use Amazon Athena to query the logs.

stem: A company is developing a new web application that serves static and dynamic content through an API. The company wants to minimize latency for users accessing the application from around the world. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text: Deploy the static content to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to serve dynamic content. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket and HTTP API as origins. Enable caching for static content.
Deploy the static content to an Amazon S3 bucket. Give users the bucket's website endpoint. Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with caching enabled to serve dynamic content.

Deploy the static content to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use two Amazon EC2 instances as web servers. Deploy an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket to cache static content.
Deploy the static content to an Amazon S3 bucket. Give users the bucket's website endpoint. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket to cache static content.

stem: A company plans to deploy a managed MySQL database solution for a non-production application. The company plans to run the system on AWS for several years. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text: Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Purchase a Reserved Instance.
Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Use On-Demand pricing.
Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster with a writer node and a reader node. Use On-Demand pricing for the cluster.
Create an Amazon EC2 instance. Manually install and configure MySQL Server on the instance.

stem: A company is concerned about its Amazon RDS database. The workload is unpredictable, and periodic spikes in new user registrations could cause the company to run out of storage. The database runs on a general purpose instance with 300 GiB of storage. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text: Enable RDS storage autoscaling.
Schedule vertical instance scaling.
Change the database to a storage optimized instance type and vertically scale the database.
Configure an AWS Lambda function to increase RDS storage by 1 GiB when storage runs low.

stem: A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances running Amazon Linux. The instances are behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and belong to an Auto Scaling group. Each instance uses an Amazon EBS volume to store product manuals. New instances often have outdated data and can take up to 30 minutes to receive updates from an external source. The company must ensure that all instances have the latest product manuals. The solution must adapt quickly to growing demand without changes to the application code. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Store the product manuals on instance store volumes attached to each EC2 instance.
Store the product manuals in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to download updates from the S3 bucket.
Store the product manuals on an Amazon EFS volume. Mount the EFS volume on the EC2 instances.
Store the product manuals in an Amazon S3 bucket using the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Configure the EC2 instances to download updates from the S3 bucket.

stem: A company wants to deploy its containerized application at scale. The company also wants to adopt software solutions from the Kubernetes open-source community. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Deploy the application on an Amazon EKS cluster. Use EKS managed node groups with Amazon EC2 instances.
Deploy the application on an Amazon EKS cluster. Use EKS Auto Mode.
Run the application on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster running on Amazon EC2 instances.
Run the containerized application as an AWS Lambda function.

stem: A company is developing a mobile financial application that allows users to register and store personal information. The application stores user information and preferences in an Amazon DynamoDB table and uses the data to generate credit score reports. The application sends users a credit report once a month. The company must give users the option to delete their data and preferences. The application must delete customer data within one month of receiving a deletion request. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete user information. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs when the specified TTL expires. Configure the rule to invoke the Lambda function.

Create a DynamoDB stream. Create an AWS Lambda function to delete user information. Write user information from the DynamoDB table to the stream when the specified TTL expires. Configure the stream to invoke the function to delete the user information.

Enable TTL in DynamoDB. Store the expiration date as an attribute. Create an AWS Lambda function that sets the TTL based on the expiration date. Invoke the function when a user requests deletion of personal data.
Enable TTL in DynamoDB. Create an AWS Lambda function to delete user information. Configure AWS Config to detect changes in DynamoDB when the TTL expires and invoke the function.

stem: A global company operates in multiple AWS Regions to meet data residency requirements. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage accounts. The company wants to restrict IAM roles to specific Regions to prevent unintended data operations across geographic boundaries. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Configure a service control policy (SCP) that denies ec2:RunInstances in noncompliant Regions.
Configure IAM policies using the aws:RequestedRegion condition.
Configure IAM role trust policies using the aws:SourceIp condition.
Configure AWS Config to detect unwanted cross-Region access.

stem: A data science workload needs storage for nightly log processing. The size and number of logs are unknown, and the logs are retained for only 24 hours. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.text: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
Amazon S3 Standard
Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering
Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

stem: An insurance company is developing an application to record individual user data, including names, ages, and health conditions. The company wants to run the application in private subnets on AWS. Data security requirements mandate access to the operating system of the compute resources running the application tier. The company must use a low-latency NoSQL database to store the data. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier and Amazon DynamoDB tables for the database tier. Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. Assign the instances an instance profile that allows access to DynamoDB.
Use AWS Lambda functions for the application tier and Amazon DynamoDB tables for the database tier. Assign the Lambda functions an appropriate IAM role to access the tables.
Use AWS Fargate for the application tier. Create an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL instance in private subnets for the database tier.
Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier. Store data in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the application to use Amazon Athena to read and write data in the S3 bucket.

stem: A company stores a file in Amazon S3. The file contains IP addresses and must be readable by the company's firewalls, which are not deployed on AWS. The company wants to restrict file access to the firewalls' IP addresses. Amazon S3 Block Public Access is configured for the AWS account. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Configure the S3 bucket as a static website. Create a bucket policy that restricts website access to the firewalls' IP addresses. Add the static website URL to the firewall settings.
Create a bucket policy that explicitly allows access only from the firewalls' IP addresses. Add the file URL to the firewall settings.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as an origin. Create an origin access control (OAC) that allows access only from the firewalls' IP addresses.

Create an AWS Lambda function that can access the file. Configure the function to verify that a request's IP address belongs to one of the firewalls and return the list. Add the Lambda function URL to the firewall settings.

stem: A company is developing an application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company plans to make regular schema changes to test new features. Testing must not affect the existing production database. After testing, developers need to apply the changes to production. The solution must minimize downtime. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Create a new temporary Aurora MySQL DB cluster based on the existing database. Make schema changes to the temporary cluster to test new features.
Create a read replica of the existing Aurora MySQL database. Make schema changes to the read replica. After successful testing, promote the read replica to the primary instance.

Create a blue/green deployment for the Aurora MySQL database. Make schema changes in the staging environment to test new features. After testing, direct traffic from the green environment to the blue environment.
Copy the Aurora MySQL database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Make structural changes to the DynamoDB table to test new features. After testing, configure the application to use the DynamoDB table.

stem: A solutions architect is building a static website to deploy on Amazon S3 for production. The website integrates with an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database through AWS Lambda functions. The production website uses a Lambda alias that points to a specific function version. The company must rotate database credentials every two weeks. Previously deployed Lambda functions must be able to use the latest credentials. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable rotation. Write code in the Lambda functions to retrieve credentials from Secrets Manager.
Include the database credentials in the Lambda function code. Update the credentials regularly and deploy new Lambda functions.
Use Lambda environment variables. Update the environment variables when new credentials become available.
Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Enable rotation. Write code in the Lambda functions to retrieve credentials from Parameter Store.

stem: A company wants to use AWS Systems Manager to manage a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. Security requirements prohibit all EC2 instances from accessing the internet. A solutions architect must design network connectivity between the EC2 instances and Systems Manager while meeting this requirement. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Deploy the EC2 instances in a private subnet with no route to the internet.
Configure an interface VPC endpoint for Systems Manager. Update routing to use the endpoint.
Deploy a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet with a default route to the NAT gateway.
Deploy an internet gateway. Configure network ACLs to deny traffic to all destinations except Systems Manager.

stem: A retail company stores customer behavior and session activity in Amazon DynamoDB. The company wants to run SQL queries in Amazon Redshift to track customer trends with regular updates. The company needs to automatically replicate data to Amazon Redshift without developing or managing extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Use AWS Glue to run scheduled ETL jobs that extract data from DynamoDB and load it into Amazon Redshift.
Use DynamoDB Streams with AWS Lambda functions to send near-real-time updates to Amazon Redshift.
Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query data exported from DynamoDB to Amazon S3.
Create a zero-ETL integration between DynamoDB and Amazon Redshift.

stem: A global ecommerce company is designing a three-tier application on AWS. The web tier serves static content, the application tier handles business logic, and the database tier stores product information and user data. The application interacts with a relational database. The company needs a highly available architecture that serves global users with low latency. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups for both the web tier and application tier in the same AWS Region. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute web traffic. Use an Amazon RDS database with a Multi-AZ deployment for the database tier.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as its origin. Deploy the application tier in every AWS Region where the company operates, using Amazon ECS containers on AWS Fargate. Use an Amazon Aurora global database for the database tier.

Use an Amazon S3 bucket for static web content. Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling and EC2 Spot Instances for the application tier. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with read replicas for the database tier. Use AWS DMS to replicate data to a secondary AWS Region.

Use an Amazon S3 bucket for static web content. Use AWS Lambda functions for serverless backend logic in the application tier. Use Amazon API Gateway to invoke the functions to handle web requests. Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database tier and deploy it across multiple AWS Regions.

stem: A solutions architect designs an application that allows users to access images stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon EC2 instances in a private VPC with the ID vpc-11aabb22. The solutions architect enables S3 Block Public Access on the bucket. The bucket is in us-west-2 in account 123456789012. Only resources in the VPC hosting the EC2 instances must be able to access the S3 bucket. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Create an S3 bucket policy statement with a Deny effect and the condition "StringNotEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-11aabb22"}.
Create an S3 bucket policy statement with an Allow effect and a Resource of "arn:aws:ec2:us-west-2:123456789012:vpc/vpc-11aabb22".

options.text: Create a VPC endpoint for AWS Systems Manager in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Allow inbound access from the endpoint security group to the EC2 instance security group on port 22. Create an IAM role for the instance and attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy.

Create an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows inbound connections on port 443. Assign the AmazonEC2InstanceConnect IAM managed policy to the developers' group.

Create an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows inbound connections on port 22. Assign the AmazonEC2InstanceConnect IAM managed policy to the developers' group.

Create a VPC endpoint for AWS Systems Manager in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Allow inbound access from the endpoint security group to the EC2 instance security group on port 22. Create an IAM role for the instance and attach the AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess policy.

stem: A company's website runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). An Amazon CloudFront distribution is in front of the ALB. Users report performance problems. A solutions architect discovers that the website is receiving high-rate requests from a range of source IP addresses through CloudFront. What should the solutions architect do?

options.text: Use AWS Shield to configure a deny rule with an IP match condition containing the unwanted request source IP addresses.
Use Auto Scaling and increase the maximum instance count to absorb unwanted requests.
Use Amazon VPC network ACLs to configure an inbound deny rule for each unwanted source IP address's CIDR block.
Use AWS WAF to configure a rate-based rule in a web ACL on the CloudFront distribution, with a rate limit below that of the unwanted requesters.

stem: A company uses an Active Directory-based identity service that supports SAML 2.0. The company wants to use its existing authentication solution to access the AWS Management Console. A solutions architect must configure federated authentication. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Create a new trust provider using AWS Verified Access. Connect the existing Active Directory IdP service to a Verified Access endpoint.
Create an identity pool using Amazon Cognito. Add the existing Active Directory IdP to the user pool. Upload the SAML metadata.

Use AWS Amplify Auth to configure a custom authentication backend. Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Node.js application that connects AWS IAM Identity Center to on-premises Active Directory through LDAP.
Configure AWS IAM Identity Center to use an external IdP. Supply the SAML metadata from the identity provider.

stem: A company plans to deploy a business-critical application in the AWS Cloud. The application requires durable storage with consistent performance and low latency. Which storage type should a solutions architect recommend?

options.text: Instance store volumes
An Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached) cluster
Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon EBS volumes
Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon EBS volumes

stem: A financial company processes transactions from multiple payment providers through its AWS infrastructure. The company needs a system that sends high-value transactions to a fraud detection service, routes failed transactions to a retry queue, copies international transactions to a compliance monitoring system, and archives all transactions for auditing. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Configure Amazon EventBridge input transformers to modify event structures before basic filtering on event types.
Create a separate Amazon EventBridge event bus for each payment provider. Use context-based routing with event patterns that match the conditions.
Use Amazon EventBridge Pipes to filter events and route them to different target systems.
Create an Amazon EventBridge event bus with multiple rules. Configure each rule to use event pattern matching for the specified conditions.

stem: A company runs a MySQL database on AWS and needs a disaster recovery (DR) plan. The company wants regular database backups and must retain copies in its on-premises DR data center so that the database can be restored locally if necessary. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create individual RDS DB snapshots and export them to Amazon S3. Use the aws s3 sync command to synchronize the snapshots to the on-premises DR data center.
Configure AWS Backup to run and manage RDS backups. Copy the backups to a vault in the on-premises DR data center.
Use mysqldump to export the database, store the export in Amazon S3, and synchronize it to the on-premises DR data center daily.
Create individual RDS DB snapshots and export them to Amazon S3. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the snapshots to the on-premises DR data center.

stem: A company runs multiple applications on Amazon EC2 instances in a single VPC. The applications need to encrypt and decrypt specific data items in records exchanged between them. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Encrypt the Amazon EBS storage associated with each application's EC2 instances.
Use AWS KMS AWS owned symmetric keys.
Use AWS KMS customer managed symmetric keys.
Use a virtual private gateway to encrypt traffic between applications.

stem: A company manages millions of documents in hundreds of Amazon S3 buckets across multiple AWS Regions. The company must determine whether the buckets contain personally identifiable information (PII). Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Use Amazon Detective to detect PII in the S3 buckets.
Use AWS Trusted Advisor to generate PII notifications.
Use Amazon Macie to detect PII in the S3 buckets.
Use an AWS Lambda function to review every file in the S3 buckets for PII.

stem: A company is deploying an application that processes streaming data in near real time. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to provide the lowest latency between nodes. Which networking solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Place the EC2 instances in multiple VPCs and configure VPC peering.
Attach an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) to each EC2 instance.
Run the EC2 instances in a spread placement group.
Use Amazon EBS-optimized instance types.

stem: A company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve content pages for its website. The company must ensure that customers use TLS certificates when accessing the website. It wants to automate certificate creation and renewal. Which solution meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently?

options.text: Use a CloudFront security policy to create the certificates.
Use CloudFront origin access control (OAC) to create the certificates.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create the certificates. Use DNS validation for the domain name.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create the certificates. Use email validation for the domain name.

stem: A solutions architect has AWS Lambda functions that need access to the company's internal data science libraries and reference data. Separate teams manage the libraries and data and must be able to update them and upload new data independently. The Lambda functions connect to the company's central VPC. Which solution gives the functions access to the libraries and data?

options.text: Attach Amazon EBS volumes to the Lambda functions using EBS Multi-Attach in the central VPC. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the volumes. Update the function code to reference files on the volumes.
Package the libraries and reference data in the Lambda /tmp directory. Update the function code to reference files in /tmp.
Create an Amazon EFS file system with mount targets in the central VPC. Configure the Lambda functions to mount it. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the file system.

Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system with mount targets in the central VPC. Configure the Lambda functions to mount it. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the file system.

stem: A company runs several highly utilized Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances in a member account of an organization in AWS Organizations. The finance team has access to both the management account and member accounts and wants to optimize costs using AWS Trusted Advisor. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use Trusted Advisor recommendations in the management account.
Use Trusted Advisor recommendations in the member account running the RDS DB instances.
Review the Trusted Advisor Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization check.
Review the Trusted Advisor Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances check.
Review the Trusted Advisor compute optimization checks. Cross-check the results with AWS Compute Optimizer.

stem: A company uses a Microsoft SQL Server database connected to its application. The company wants to migrate to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with minimal application code changes. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to rewrite SQL queries in the application.
Enable Babelfish on Aurora PostgreSQL to run the application's SQL queries.
Use AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database schema and data.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to connect the application to Aurora PostgreSQL.
Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rewrite SQL queries in the application.

stem: A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. It runs Amazon EC2 instances in four AWS accounts under the root organizational unit (OU): three non-production accounts and one production account. The company wants to prevent users in non-production accounts from launching certain EC2 instance sizes. It creates a service control policy (SCP) that denies launching the prohibited instance types. Which ways of deploying the SCP meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Attach the SCP to the organization's root OU.
Attach the SCP to the three non-production member accounts.
Attach the SCP to the organization's management account.
Create an OU for the production account. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the production member account into the new OU.
Create an OU for the required accounts. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the non-production member accounts into the new OU.

stem: A company runs an application as a task in an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The application needs read and write access to a specific set of Amazon S3 buckets. The buckets and ECS cluster are in the same AWS Region and account. The company must grant access according to the principle of least privilege. Which combination of solutions meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Add a tag to each bucket. Create an IAM policy with a StringEquals condition matching the buckets' tags and values.
Create an IAM policy listing the full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of each S3 bucket.
Attach the IAM policy to the instance role for the ECS task.
Create an IAM policy with a wildcard Amazon Resource Name (ARN) matching the combination of all S3 bucket names.
Attach the IAM policy to the ECS task role.

stem: A company has a single AWS account with workloads in multiple VPCs in one AWS Region. It also has on-premises workloads connected to AWS through AWS Direct Connect. All EC2 instances in the VPCs must resolve DNS queries for internal.example.com through authoritative DNS servers in the on-premises data center. Communication between the VPCs and the on-premises network must remain private. All route tables, network ACLs, and security groups are correctly configured. Which combination of actions meets these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text: Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in every workload VPC.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint in one workload VPC.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule of type Forward to forward internal.example.com queries to the on-premises DNS servers.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule of type System configured to forward internal.example.com queries to the on-premises DNS servers.
Associate the Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule with all workload VPCs.
Associate the Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule with the workload VPC containing the new Route 53 endpoint.

stem: A company stores sensitive user information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to provide secure access to the bucket from an application tier running on Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take? (Choose two.)

options.text: Configure a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
Create a bucket policy that makes objects in the S3 bucket public.
Create a bucket policy that restricts access to the application tier running in the VPC.
Create an IAM user with an S3 access policy and copy the IAM credentials to the EC2 instances.
Create a NAT instance and have the EC2 instances use it to access the S3 bucket.

stem: A social media company lets users upload images to a website running on Amazon EC2 instances. During each upload request, the website resizes the image to a standard size and stores the resized image in Amazon S3. Users are experiencing slow uploads. The company needs to reduce application coupling and improve performance. A solutions architect must design the MOST operationally efficient upload workflow. Which combination of actions meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Configure the application to upload images to S3 Glacier.
Configure the web servers to upload original images to Amazon S3.
Configure the application to upload images directly from each user's browser to Amazon S3 using presigned URLs.
Configure S3 event notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded. Use the function to resize the image.
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to resize uploaded images.

stem: A company uses an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company must use IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) to give Kubernetes service accounts secure, fine-grained access to specific AWS resources. Which combination of solutions meets these requirements?

options.text: Create an IAM policy defining the required permissions and attach it directly to the EKS nodes' IAM role.
Implement network policies in the EKS cluster to prevent Kubernetes service accounts from accessing specific AWS services.
Modify the EKS cluster's IAM role to include permissions for each Kubernetes service account. Ensure a one-to-one mapping between IAM roles and Kubernetes roles.
Define IAM roles with the necessary permissions. Annotate Kubernetes service accounts with the IAM roles' Amazon Resource Names (ARNs).
Establish a trust relationship between the IAM role for a service account and the OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider.

stem: A company hosts an application on AWS that lets users upload photos and stores them in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon CloudFront and a custom domain name to upload photo files to the S3 bucket in eu-west-1. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in us-east-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads through CloudFront origin access control (OAC).
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an S3 website endpoint.

stem: A company runs workloads on AWS and manages accounts with AWS Organizations. The company needs to identify which departments are responsible for specific costs. New accounts are continuously added to the organization. Its continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) framework already adds a populated department tag to AWS resources. The company wants AWS Cost Explorer reports showing service costs by department across all AWS accounts. Which combination of steps meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently? (Choose two.)

options.text: Activate both the aws:createdBy and department cost allocation tags in the management account.
Create a new cost and usage report in Cost Explorer. Group by the department cost allocation tag. Apply filters to view all linked accounts and services.
Activate only the department cost allocation tag in the management account.
Create a new cost and usage report in Cost Explorer. Group by the department cost allocation tag without additional filters.
Activate only the aws:createdBy cost allocation tag in the management account.

stem: A company creates a VPC with one public subnet and one private subnet and attaches an internet gateway to the VPC. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the public subnet communicates with Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnet. The private instances must download operating system (OS) and application updates from the internet but must not be accessible from the internet. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.text: Associate an Elastic IP address with the NAT gateway.
Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the private subnet route table with the NAT gateway as the target.
Deploy a NAT gateway in the public subnet.
Deploy a NAT gateway in the private subnet.
Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the public subnet route table with the NAT gateway as the target.
Associate an Elastic IP address with the internet gateway.
